paths.title: AI Coding Workflows Academy
paths.tagline: Team-level coding workflows across Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor — from steering completions to running the whole delivery pipeline.
paths.description: An eight-lesson path through the coding workflows a team actually needs across three tools, not the basics each tool's own academy already covers: steering Cursor Tab's completions with comments, open files, and Rules; choosing between Cursor Chat and Claude Code to get unblocked fast without re-deriving what a teammate already knows; picking the right agent surface — interactive or unattended — for a scoped multi-file change; turning a GitHub issue into a reviewed pull request with Codex cloud tasks or Claude Code; running AI code review as a disciplined first pass with Codex or Claude Code's /code-review; replacing three drifting instruction files with one canonical AGENTS.md shared across CLAUDE.md and .cursor/rules; and rolling out a consistent tool-selection, access, and usage policy across a whole team.
